messages:
Emma Chen: Quick heads-up — Horizon POC kickoff scheduled tomorrow 10am PST. I pushed an agenda in the calendar. Need a one-pager of success criteria and the security questionnaire answers before EOD.
Raj Patel: Thanks — can we confirm expected QPS and token budget? Will need to pick model variant and quantization.
Devon Brooks: For pricing, customer asked about Dedicated vs Hosted cost for a 2-week POC. I can draft a ballpark if we get expected concurrency and seq lengths.
Sophie Morales: Security questions: are they asking for SOC2 in-scope data flows or just app-level controls? Also need data residency and retention policy.
Matt Nguyen: Success metrics from product: latency p95 < 350ms, accuracy (top-1 match) >= 85% on their gold set, and cost per 1k tokens <$2. We'll confirm.
Emma Chen: Nice, add to prep: sample prompts + 200 labeled examples for eval, network egress rules, VPN requirements. Can someone own the SSO & SCQ answers? @Sophie?
Sophie Morales: I can take SSO and SCQ. Need contact at Horizon for their compliance lead and sample Data Flow diagram (they said 'sensitive PII maybe present').
Raj Patel: For prompts — ask them to provide 50 representative user queries and 50 failure cases. Also we should include a warm-up script and KV cache considerations. Example prompt set:

`````
System: You are a helpful assistant for HR policies.
User: How do I file for parental leave?
Expected: Steps 1-4, link to policy, timeframe.
`````

Raj Patel: I'll prep an eval harness with BLEU + custom scoring; need timeframe to run 10k tokens / run.
Devon Brooks: Ballpark pricing: Hosted API ~ $150/day for the test volume if short bursts; Dedicated reserve = ~$5k/mo pro-rated — these are rough until we get QPS and token estimates.
horizon-bot: calendar event created: 'Horizon POC kickoff' — 10:00am PST / 2024-04-05 — attendees: Emma, Raj, Sophie, Matt, Horizon: alice.j@horizon.co
Matt Nguyen: Can we add rollback/fallback policy as success criteria? If model fails >10% of eval cases, automatic fallback to smaller model with higher precision.
Emma Chen: Good call. Also add rollback SLA and monitoring: tracing + per-route cost breakdown in Console.
Sophie Morales: Security checklist: encryption in transit + at rest, KMS usage, audit logs retention 90 days, access control via SSO & SCIM.
Raj Patel: Action items:
- Raj: prep eval harness + sample prompts (today)
- Sophie: SCQ/Security answers + compliance contact (today)
- Devon: ballpark pricing and Dedicated delta (today)
- Matt: success criteria doc + rollback policy (today)
- Emma: coordinate with Horizon for dataset + stakeholder list (ASAP)

Emma Chen: If we can get all pre-reads by EOD we can run a dry-run of the eval pre-kickoff. Thanks team :pray:
Alice Johnson: Thanks the team — I'll send the 50 queries and compliance lead contact this afternoon.
Devon Brooks: noted, will prep pricing ping for the call.
Raj Patel: I'll also include a short note about quantization tradeoffs and perf expectations during the call.
Emma Chen: Great — see you all tomorrow. /remind me to follow up if pre-reads missing 9am PST tomorrow
